patch_description: Replace the final single-proposal hill climb with batched active-set repair. Near strong Heilbronn configurations, the limiting determinants usually share vertices, so independently perturbing one point rarely improves the strict minimum. This refinement explicitly identifies points participating in the smallest triples and perturbs them jointly, while allowing controlled lower-tail balancing early in the search. It retains the best strictly feasible candidate throughout and remains deterministic under the existing fixed seed.
